newsitem.title: USA: Hughes Data awarded $171 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: Hughes Data awarded $171 mln contract.

text.p: Hughes Electronics Corp., a unit of Hughes Data Systems, said Tuesday it has been awarded a contract worth up to $171 million from the Patent and Trademark Office to make desktop workstations, monitors, printers and related items.
Hughes said the one-year fixed-price contract is worth $152 million, with a potential maximum value of $171 million. The contract has two one-year options.
